items.headline: AI agents consume far more tokens than simple chat prompts
items.summary: Developers' coding tasks for AI agents involve planning, code generation, testing and iteration, using ten to fifty times more tokens than a basic prompt.
items.why_it_matters: Higher token use impacts cost and efficiency of AI‑driven development.
items.evidence_quote: A single task can use 10 to 50 times more tokens than a basic chat prompt.

items.headline: OpenAI to respect robots.txt signal for AI training preferences
items.summary: OpenAI announced it will honour a shared robots.txt signal, allowing sites to convey their AI training preferences to providers.
items.why_it_matters: It gives website owners control over how their content is used to train AI models.
items.evidence_quote: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

items.headline: OpenAI adds stronger violence prevention safeguards to ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI announced expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new public safety reporting commitment to improve violence prevention in ChatGPT.
items.why_it_matters: OpenAI is pairing the new safeguards with a public commitment to report on safety.
items.evidence_quote: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.

items.headline: Exploit found in ChatGPT's artifacts pattern allowing sandbox escape
items.summary: Parameter Labs identified a complex attack chain exploiting ChatGPT’s artifacts (HTML preview) pattern, allowing untrusted code to inject HTML into the parent page.
items.why_it_matters: It shows an HTML preview sandbox can be bypassed when untrusted code is able to inject HTML into the page around it.
items.evidence_quote: Parameter Labs describe an exploit they found against ChatGPT's implementation of the artifacts pattern

items.headline: Apple to introduce Apple Intelligence in China via iOS 27.3
items.summary: Apple announced that Apple Intelligence will debut in China with the iOS 27.3 beta on 4 Nov, followed by a full release in December.
items.why_it_matters: Brings AI features to Chinese iPhone users, expanding Apple's market presence.
items.evidence_quote: Apple will launch Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3, the company announced on its Chinese newsroom website
